title: Hold the standard and explain the path to it
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Locate the gap — Name the specific part of the work that needs revision.; Explain the requirement — Describe what the standard protects and why it applies.; Define acceptance — State the evidence that would make the work adequate.; Review the revision — Acknowledge completion or explain the remaining issue..

steps.detail: Name the specific part of the work that needs revision.

steps.detail: Describe what the standard protects and why it applies.
